title: [spec-gap][R-X509-001/006/007/008/009/010/045/046/055] Leaf certificate profile conformance: SPKI Ed25519 identity key, hygiene, sig-alg floor
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md sections 1, 2, 7: leaf in x5chain MUST conform to the profile; version MUST be v3 (2); MUST NOT include CRL Distribution Points, AIA, or OCSP no-check markers, and verifiers MUST NOT be required to process them; EKU absent by default, id-kp-clientAuth if present; SPKI MUST be Ed25519 id-Ed25519 1.3.101.112 with absent params and 32-byte raw key, no other algorithms; subject key MUST be the node identity key from which addresses derive; signature alg MUST be SHA-256-class or stronger or id-Ed25519, MD5/SHA-1 MUST NOT be used; tbsCertificate.signature MUST equal outer signatureAlgorithm. Classification: not-implemented (no certificate encoder or leaf validator in any stack). Suggested placement: cert-profile module (SAN binding bead site) plus CA issuance tool (PoP bead site); validator rejects forbidden extensions and non-conforming SPKI.
